Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude designed protein binders from scratch and beat the human competition winners. OpenAI will stop collecting some customers’ data, a study of 26,000 students found AI homework wrecks exam scores, and Jensen Huang says AI is struggling with locations, not just compute.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** How did Claude beat the human protein champions?

* **OpenAI:** What did it promise it will never look at?

* **Students:** Why did AI homework tank their exams?

* **Nvidia:** What is Jensen calling the real bottleneck?


----------



----------
## Claude beat the humans at designing real molecules

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ff4a7c27-bf75-49f1-b292-eb6bb0107e23/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_20__2026__01_17_06_AM.png?t=1787178342)
Caption: 

[Adaptyv Bio](https://www.adaptyvbio.com/blog/anthropic-1) runs competitions where human experts build molecules that stick to a target. Anthropic entered Claude's designs anonymized, and the lab tested them without knowing which model made what.

Claude would have won five of six. It’s beating humans at making drugs.

For those in this field. Its best design beat the winner out of 245 entries. On another target it took the best binder from 1.7 µM to 33.4 nM, roughly 50 times tighter.

Out of 1,320 designs, 354 bound their target. **That's 26.8 percent where the field averages 10 to 15. **

Claude succeeded on 14 of 15 targets in sessions of 24 to 48 hours, work that takes a specialist weeks or months per target.

One target got zero binders out of 90 tries, and none of these are drugs yet. 

Monday, Dario Amodei said AI has to actually cure cancer to win people back. This is the first receipt.


----------











----------
## Your AI keeps optimizing the wrong thing

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/d2632593-c6d3-48bf-a807-81f89e4ba4bc/ChatGPT_Image_Aug_20__2026__01_48_37_AM.png?t=1787179755)
Follow image link: (https://utm.genai.works/r/ttsipuf)
Caption: 



Most industrial AI dies the same way. It optimizes one goal and ignores the rest, so speed eats energy costs and quality fights throughput.
